confirmed_blockers.title: PNG16 low-bit differences disappear during decoding
confirmed_blockers.observed: Both arms certify complete/exact and automatic absence passed although independent raw PNG16 decode proves one unequal original red channel sample. IHDR is bit depth16/color type2. Pillow exposes RGB and discards the low bits before the provider compares.
confirmed_blockers.expected: No full/absence credit from unequal originals or an unsupported original encoding. Lossy conversion cannot replace original pixels.
confirmed_blockers.reach: Direct certificate, bound state, execution coverage and automatic absence; no native/final delivery pass claimed.

confirmed_blockers.title: Later intersections invalidate an earlier independent witness clause
confirmed_blockers.observed: Both arms accept a3-frame coherent raster chain. Link0 has only A/B witnesses. Final exact rational domains force A=[201,211), B=[210,220), so no final joint assignment makes that link disjoint. The later link has C/D and is accepted while the earlier witness clause is not rechecked.
confirmed_blockers.expected: One assignment must satisfy every original link and global identity/order constraints jointly.
confirmed_blockers.reach: Direct certificate, bound state, execution coverage, routing and automatic absence.

confirmed_blockers.title: Viewport-local presence/uniqueness values are treated as conflicting state values
confirmed_blockers.observed: With a valid coherent full sweep, a target missing in early lazy frames but present late produces U for present:true/unique:true, and U rather than F for present:false. An explicit duplicate in an early frame followed by one match later produces U for unique:true instead of decisive F. Seen-early/missing-later and nonunique expectation variants also remain U.
confirmed_blockers.expected: State presence is existential over coherent original frames; absence requires complete never-present evidence; a real duplicate witness cannot be cancelled by a later single match.
confirmed_blockers.reach: Automatic typed evaluator in both common arms. Absent-all full and mixed-epoch/incomplete-negative controls behave correctly.

confirmed_blockers.title: Coverage-domain verification omits approved runtime host shape
confirmed_blockers.observed: Prepared approval/request/source namespace/original component copy/mock compiled log/captured and compiled host bytes match the pinned neutral domain. Coherently halving logical app/viewport/content/leaf rectangles to195x300 while retaining390x600 original PNGs is still granted full_content and absence P by both arms. The fixed approval requires logical390x600 and verified runtime shape/mapping.
confirmed_blockers.expected: Wrong runtime host shape cannot authorize full-content or absence through the fallback.
confirmed_blockers.reach: Coverage/domain/absence misclassification only. Independent environment gate is F and blocks whole final delivery; no final acceptance bypass asserted.
